marketplace.summary: Frames testable aims, drafts agency-aligned proposal sections, and stress-tests them with structured mock review, verifying the current funding notice and never inventing preliminary data, citations, budgets, or reviewer scores.

skills.name: grant-proposal-assistant
skills.description: Drafts and revises NIH, NSF, and similar proposal sections from structured templates, with a heuristic structure checklist for existing drafts.

skills.name: grant-specific-aims-writer
skills.description: Writes or revises a one-page NIH Specific Aims page or NSF Project Summary using a problem, gap, hypothesis, and aims logic chain.

skills.name: aim-and-hypothesis-designer
skills.description: Turns a broad research idea into one primary aim, bounded secondary aims, and testable hypotheses separated from exploratory work.

skills.name: grant-mock-reviewer
skills.description: Simulates structured NIH-style critique of significance, innovation, approach, investigators, and environment to prioritize revisions.

skills.name: grant-budget-justification
skills.description: Writes narrative justifications for personnel, equipment, supplies, and travel lines that the applicant has already costed.

skills.name: novelty-vs-feasibility-assessor
skills.description: Separates true from pseudo-novelty, audits feasibility under stated constraints, and forces a start, narrow, redesign, or stop decision.

skills.name: feasibility-aware-study-planner
skills.description: Scales a study idea to the best executable version under stated sample, time, budget, data-access, and team constraints.

skills.name: sample-size-and-power-planning-assistant
skills.display_name: Sample Size and Power Planning Assistant
skills.description: Plans sample-size logic, power assumptions, and fallback enrollment scenarios without fabricating exact calculations from missing inputs.
